description: This PHP class 'EmailConfigurationService' provides services related to email configuration management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve DAO and email service instances, and to send test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling email configuration operations such as managing DAO and email service instances and sending test emails.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the EmailConfigurationDao instance used for database interactions related to email configuration.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the EmailService instance used for sending emails.

methods.name: setEmailService
methods.description: Sets the EmailService instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Uses the EmailService to send a test email to the specified address, potentially throwing an exception.
